Change c0089. Location: 1818 Vol. I, Ch. III; 1831 Ch. IV.

Context before (unchanged): It was with these feelings that I began the creation of a human being.

1818 text: As the minuteness of the parts formed a great hindrance to my speed, I resolved, contrary to my first intention, to make the being of a gigantic stature; that is to say, about eight feet in height, and proportionably large.

1831 text: As the minuteness of the parts formed a great hinderance to my speed, I resolved, contrary to my first intention, to make the being of a gigantic stature; that is to say, about eight feet in height, and proportionably large.

Diff: As the minuteness of the parts formed a great [-hindrance-] {+hinderance+} to my speed, I resolved, contrary to my first intention, to make the being of a gigantic stature; that is to say, about eight feet in height, and proportionably large.

Context after (unchanged): After having formed this determination, and having spent some months in successfully collecting and arranging my materials, I began.

result.rationale: Only the orthography of one word changes: 'hindrance' becomes 'hinderance'. The wording, meaning and sense of the sentence are unchanged, so there is no interpretive consequence.
